info.name: SWOT API
info.description: Colección de pruebas del backend de SWOT. Ejecútala completa con el Collection Runner (en orden): inicia sesión con los 4 roles, recorre el flujo completo de una OT y comprueba los errores de permisos, validación y seguridad. Requiere el backend en {{baseUrl}} y la base con los datos de prueba de database/init.sql.

item.name: 1. Auth
item.description: Cada login guarda su token en una variable de la colección (dispatcherToken, driverToken, adminToken, supervisorToken). El límite de intentos fallidos es de 5 cada 2 minutos por IP: no repitas los casos 401 muchas veces seguidas.

item.name: Login with a SQL injection attempt (401, not 500)
Protected route with a garbage token (401)
List orders with an invalid status / SQL injection (400)
List orders with an invalid date (400)
Create order with products (weight is calculated)

request.description: Product 4 is the Cement bag (25 kg). Two bags weigh 50 kg: the typed 999 is ignored.

item.name: Create order without weight and without products (400)

request.description: The order weighs 6000 kg and vehicle 1 (AB1234) carries 5000 kg.
Vehicle 2 (CD5678) has an expired inspection in the test data.

item.name: Schedule the same order again (409, only Created can be scheduled)

exec: pm.test('contains the scheduled order', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().some((o) => o.id === Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('orderId')))).to.be.true);

item.name: Dispatcher cannot see the driver route (403)
Deliver directly from Scheduled (409, must go InTransit first)
Detail after delivery: proof of delivery and history

exec: pm.test('has the receiver RUT and the photo', () => { pm.expect(o.order.receiverTaxId).to.eql('11.111.111-1'); pm.expect(o.order.deliveryPhoto).to.include('data:image'); });

Create customer with an invalid RUT (400)

const r = 11 - (sum % 11); const dv = r === 11 ? '0' : r === 10 ? 'K' : String(r);

item.name: A deactivated customer cannot receive orders (409)
Create vehicle with an invalid plate (400)

exec: const L = () => String.fromCharCode(65 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 26)); pm.collectionVariables.set('plate', L() + L() + L() + L() + String(10 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 90)));

exec: pm.test('has both lists', () => { const a = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(a.vehicles).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(a.overdueOrders).to.be.an('array'); });

item.name: Filter containers with a SQL injection attempt (400)

exec: pm.test('has the yard numbers', () => { const s = pm.response.json(); ['expected', 'inYard', 'departed', 'overstays', 'freeDays'].forEach((k) => pm.expect(s).to.have.property(k)); });

item.name: Announce with a wrong check digit (400)
Announce perishable cargo in a dry container (400)

exec: const val = (ch) => { if (/\d/.test(ch)) return Number(ch); let v = 10; for (const c of 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ') { if (v % 11 === 0) v++; if (c === ch) return v; v++; } };
const digit = String(([...body].reduce((t, c, i) => t + val(c) * Math.pow(2, i), 0) % 11) % 10);

request.description: The number is generated with a valid ISO 6346 check digit and the test prefix PMNU, so it is easy to clean up afterwards.

item.name: Create a driver for the map
Create an order for that customer
Schedule it to the map driver
The route carries the delivery point

exec: pm.test('has the coordinates of the customer', () => { const o = pm.response.json()[0]; pm.expect(o.customerLatitude).to.eql(-33.05); pm.expect(o.customerLongitude).to.eql(-71.55); });

item.name: Report a position before starting the route (409)
The dispatcher cannot see the fleet (403)
The supervisor sees the truck with its position and destination

exec: pm.test('the truck is on the map', () => { const t = pm.response.json().find((x) => x.orderId === Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('mapOrderId'))); pm.expect(t.driverName).to.eql('Postman Map Driver'); pm.expect(t.position.latitude).to.eql(-33.02); pm.expect(t.destination.latitude).to.eql(-33.05); });

item.name: The truck left the map after the delivery

exec: pm.test('the order is no longer in transit', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().some((x) => x.orderId === Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('mapOrderId')))).to.be.false);
